decisions.reason: Two-component resin injection units are long-lived capital equipment in a specialized niche, and the product had its own page through 2019, so continued sales and service support are likely.
This second injection unit complements A within a stable product family, and German machinery firms rarely drop such equipment within four years of launch.
Automatic airless spray guns are core consumable-type equipment for a coating machinery maker and are typically kept in the range for many years.
Manual airless spray guns are a staple high-volume product that supports the firm's established coating equipment business.
Air-assisted airless guns serve finishing customers with steady demand and fit the existing spray gun portfolio.
Its fall from its own page to a mention in 2019 points to weak traction or being folded into other offerings, but its digital monitoring role likely keeps it worth maintaining for now.
